Three Cliffs Bay Holiday Park - Gower Camping
2027 Bookings now open →
WELCOME TO THREE CLIFFS BAY
A remarkable place to stay.
Discover a little piece of coastal paradise on the beautiful Gower Peninsula. From traditional camping and luxury glamping to unforgettable sea views, Three Cliffs Bay is a place to slow down, explore and enjoy the simple pleasures of life outdoors.
find your stay →
Touring
All of our touring pitches are premium, as standard. Every pitch has a fire pit, picnic table, electric hook-up point and water point. Explore our touring options below.
Stay With Us
Glamping
Enjoy the luxury side of camping in one of our modern Glamping Tents, just a short walk from the beach. These spacious and luxurious new Glamping Tents sleep up to 5 comfortably. Dogs are also welcome.
Glamping Options
Gift Cards
Looking for a holiday gift for someone who would love to stay with us? Why not purchase one of our Gift Cards, which can be sent directly before Christmas. These can then be used any time in the next season.
Buy Now
One of Britain's most beautiful beaches.
Set above the golden sands of Three Cliffs Bay, our holiday park is the perfect place to unwind, explore and make unforgettable memories - whatever your style of stay.
Explore the area →
Bistro 1948 - great food to enjoy together.
From hearty breakfasts to delicious pizzas and local favourites, Bistro 1948 is at the heart of Three Cliffs Bay. Freshly prepared, locally inspired and made to be enjoyed together.
Explore Bistro 1948 →
A little luxury , a lot of fresh air.
Escape the everyday without leaving comfort behind. Our beautifully furnished glamping tents offer cosy beds, thoughtful touches and a welcoming place to unwind. With the breathtaking Gower coastline just moments away, the best of the outdoors is right on your doorstep.
Explore Glamping →
Firepit
Your own fire pit, on pitch, ready to use. Logs and starter packs can be pre-ordered before arrival or picked up during your stay.
Picnic Table
Our large 6-seater picnic tables are on pitch ready to use. Use for your own cooking, or enjoy our chef cooked food on site.
Drinking Water
A drinking water tap is provided on every pitch. Water points are also located around the site to fill your reusable containers.

FAQs | Three Cliffs Bay Holiday Park - Gower Camping
2027 Bookings now open →
FAQs
Everything you need to know before your stay at Three Cliffs Bay.
When do you open?
The site opens on Friday 3rd April 2026 and closes October 5th 2026.
Do you have a site map available?
Yes! - Click here to view our site map for 2027.
When can I book?
Bookings are now live for our 2026 season. The office is open from 8am - 7pm for enquiries, but you can book online at anytime .
Do you accept dogs?
Yes, dogs are allowed on the campsite and in the Glamping Tents. They are also allowed on the beach 12 months a year. We now have dog walking areas on-site.
Can I request a specific pitch?
For our 2026 season, you are now able to book a specific pitch within a booking area for all touring and glamping options. If you don't mind which pitch you are allocated, then you can choose just to have a pitch randomly assigned.
What are the arrival and departure times?
Your touring pitch is available from 12noon on your day of arrival, and must be vacated by 11am on your departure date. Glamping tents are available from 4pm and must be vacated by 10am. We ask that all arrivals get to site by 9pm. If you might be later than this, then please contact us before your checkin day
What deposit is required?
The deposit required equates to the minimum stay duration, or the full amount if booking within 21 days. The minimum stay is 4 nights during school holidays and busy periods, 3 days during other bank holidays, and 2 nights over busy times and weekends. The deposit is paid in full at the time of booking and not refundable. Glamping requires a 50% deposit upon booking.
Am I entitled to a refund when cancelling?
No, all payments are final and non-refundable. We can change your booking dates up to 21 days before arrival - to another date in the current season.
If you booking with our new "Three Cliffs Guarantee" rate, then you are able to cancel your booking up until 3 weeks before arrival, less a £9.99 cover charge.
Are campfires allowed on site?
No open fires are allowed. BBQs are fine as long as they do not affect the grass, and if they are charcoal based (no wood BBQs allowed).
We also provide you a small fire pit - free of charge. Logs can be pre-ordered or purchased from the farm shop.
Are bikes and skateboards allowed on site?
Yes, push bikes and skateboards are allowed on the camping fields, but are not allowed on the tarmac or roads to the reception area or around the toilet block (except for direct access). Children should only use bikes etc on the camping area or dedicated play field. This is a strict requirement and for health and safety reasons.
Electric bikes/scooters are not permitted around the site.
What is standard for every pitch?
Every pitch included (for free):
16amp electric hook-up
Drinking water tap by pitch
6-seater picnic table
Fire pit
Do all pitches have a sea view?
No, only some pitches have a sea view. Upon booking, you will be given all available view options, and you must book the required pitch type depending on what view you would like (and subject to availability).
Do you accept groups?
No, we only accept families and couples. Single guests are also welcome. We do not accept mixed or single sex groups. We have a strict 10pm latest "quiet rule", and all campers are required to keep to this, including keeping talking and noise to an absolute minimum. All music must be turned off after this time. We ask you to respect your fellow campers on site. During the start and end of the season, we might make this time limit earlier to observe the darker evenings in Spring and Autumn. If you are playing music excessively loud during the day, and it is affecting other campers, then we also reserve the right to ask you to turn it off at any point in the day.
What is the pitching arrangement?
For tents, we only allow one tent per pitch. If you have two tents, then you must book two pitches. You may park your car on pitch as well. We have pitching guide signs available on all our tent pitches. Gazebos are also permitted, as long as they follow our pitching guide.
For Caravans, MotorHomes or Smaller camper vans in our main site, the van must be placed on the right hand side of the pitch area, with your door facing the left hand side (as you look at the sea view). Any awning then must be attached to the left hand side of the van. Your awning must be attached to the van when on site. If you have a Campervan/MotorHome with a right hand sliding door, then the van must be turned around on the pitch to face the "opposite direction".
When are my extras delivered?
If you have pre-ordered a hamper or any other extra, then these will be made available on your arrival date as long as you arrive during reception hours. Late arrivals may not be able to access extras until the following morning. Please check with us regarding your hampers if you are expecting to arrive late.
Do you allow generators on site?
No, generators are not allowed on site. We provide electric for every pitch on site.
How large are the pitches?
Our caravan/motorhome pitches are 5m wide. Your van and awning must fit on to this space to allow a resonable space between each unit. We require units to be positioned 'side-on', with awnings to the side of your van. Our camping pitches for tents and small VW Campervans are mostly 9m - 10m wide
How many pitches do I need to book?
Every tent needs its own pitch. No matter how small your tent is, every tent required its own pitch to be booked. We can only take a specific number of tents, so every tent needs to be pitched on its own tent pitch. Every tent pitch has room for a car as well. If you have two very small tents, you still need to book two individual pitches.
What do I need for a tent electric?
Our electric tent pitches require a special camping hookup cable - these are standard connections that most sites use. These can be purchased at the time of booking and made available upon arrival to the site. Please
